provenance.purpose: Python-vs-NN split of warm-move cost for the Rust rewrite analysis
provenance.method: measure_online-style pass-vs-pass scenario, side 21; session.forward_policy / forward_policy_wdl wrapped with perf_counter timers tagged by evaluator entry point; python_ms = move total - NN forward time
provenance.caveat: Apple M3 Pro host, not the x86 judge. Per-forward cross-check against morpheus-export-preflight-baseline-1thread.json (Modal x86, 1 thread): root 6.2-6.5 vs 6.05 ms, leaf-of-4 20.4-20.5 vs 18.5 ms, proposal per-sample 5.3-14.2 vs 4.6-9.6 ms.

deployed_8p.note: bots/morpheus/deployment.json values: 8 particles, target 16 sims, min 8, leaf batch 4, proposal batch 8, 140 ms deadline, guard 0. Run [0] = verbatim; run [1] = same budget, uncapped deadline and NaN enemy_prior_batch offline p99 patched to a finite 20 ms, i.e. the full cost of a complete 16-sim move.
deployed_8p.nan_lockout: Verbatim run: offline_p99_ms.enemy_prior_batch is NaN, so can_admit never admits it until its 64-sample window fills with 0.0 padding; turns 1-64 mean 0.1 sims, turns 65+ mean 10.7 sims (min 8), total p50 128.7 ms.

qualification_32p.note: Phase-6 qualification floor: 32 particles, target 8 sims, leaf batch 4, proposal batch 32. Run [0] = uncapped deadline (full completeness cost); run [1] = 140 ms deadline, guard 5 ms.
